title: Conditional κ = 0.001295629942587122: rational84 whole-family packing and complex79
body:
Conditional **kappa = 0.001295629942587122**, exact `647814971293561/500000000000000000`, **0.009369487712398846% above pinned #478**. The bit side binds. This combines our repaired R715 kernel with #478's fourteen target factors and its stronger #471/478 complex supplier. All residuals remain whole on one physical family. Exact rational reconstruction of a fractional pattern assignment selects84 replicas; every pattern/copy/stage/width equality is checked before scaling and explicit physical expansion. The local word is unchanged, and no optimizer-based global optimality claim is made.

The repaired kernel has110 pivots, entrance rank119 and102 donor slots. The target factors transfer exactly because both source B programs and all used frames agree; the public #478 constructor/candidate hashes were independently reproduced first. The local delta is `{1:-14,4:-14,5:+14}` across924 calls. Complete profiles and paid costs are recomputed; gains are not added arithmetically.

Exact bit lower: `259462155455000142181/200000000000000000000000`. Complex lower: `1305231506267591/1000000000000000000`. The bit supplier uses100800 live/100809 physical families and660660 whole residual occurrences. Its fresh3412-bit physical prefix is charged3456;10301-bit three-level coefficient is charged10304; row19437<20161. The complex supplier uses8400 live/8978 physical families and43120 whole residuals, including paid full-nine-axis normalization and same-owner restored spectators. Its retained row reserve is20161.

New package: `research/r715-replica84-complex79/`. Run `python -B research/r715-replica84-complex79/verify.py /absolute/new/output`. Default freshly rebuilds both suppliers; explicit `--provider-output` binds the recorded completed full provider and all relevant data hashes, with a distinct reuse receipt. The source-derived bit reconstruction,28 factor omission controls, six non-vacuous native record controls, Gram/label/ownership/emitted-program checks, fresh invoices, two rational moment implementations and47 strict outer inequalities are included.

Validation at draft update: the84-replica construction passed exact source reconstruction over955 arbitrary-dirty columns, both moment implementations, explicit660660-occurrence assignment expansion, initial native/physical checks, fresh physical prefix and exact combined invoice/47 outer inequalities. Complete Python3.11 (explicit completed-provider reuse) and fresh default Python3.14 wrappers are running. The prior64-replica construction separately passed its full default3.14 replay; those packages and receipts remain available. Initial84-replica evidence is in `research/r715-replica84-complex79-validation/initial/`. Full84-replica verification and GitHub CI are not yet claimed passed.

Reproducibility repairs are explicit. Pinned #478's public manifest lists an absent `.gitattributes`; the original package is retained unchanged and replay makes an output-directory copy with only that missing inventory entry removed, preserving all150 existing non-manifest files and recording both hashes. macOS uses the existing portable C++ header include. Our inherited wrong-frame mutation initially assigned0 to an ADD already at frame0; it now selects a nonzero-frame ADD and asserts changed bytes. Python-dependent gzip header bytes also required binding fresh raw files and pinned complete canonical contents instead of expecting a previous run's compressed hashes. The checker retains all mathematical fields and rejects changed stocks, source bindings and provider identities. Original failures and corrected checks are preserved in validation and the [categorized experiment log, PR477](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/477).

All inherited all-size compiler, target-label/mutable-basis, complete-call correlated dirty-hosting, same-owner spectator, compressed-window, restored-work, precision, row and analytic contracts remain conditional. This is not an unconditional multiplication theorem, new Lean proof or optimum. #480's larger reported number depends on disputed cross-family splitting; this does not claim to exceed that numerical headline.

Credits: Dugongue for #478's factor witness/constructor/proof and #471/478 complex normalization/spectators; chafreaky for #472 and earlier supplier integrations; DreamingOfClouds for R715 and target mixing; DaysSky for hosting; ahrazzle for local delivery reordering; the inherited contributors named in retained notices. Repaired kernel search, composition and independent verification by Rohan Arun with OpenAI Codex assistance.
